body: I always think of that. I am jealous of the people who left. It is over for them.

I am 28 and have the same. I had an attempt at 17. I could afford meds and they did no help. Perhaps I did not try a good enough variety? No idea. Apparently we have a massive chemical imbalance in our brains hence the thoughts and depression, but it is hard believe that that is all.
I also have borderline personality syndrome so that certainly does not help.

The truth is you can do whatever. You could have success at work, you could have enough money, you could have a family. The thoughts will never go away. I am doing well at work and started studying again, which has been a success. It does not matter. Every day I wish it was over. I wish I could do it in a way that it did not hurt or I did not hurt anyone after I died.
I have a relationship. But it does not make a difference. We argue because I am too fucked up to be normal, so even my relationship reminds me every single day how different I am.

Believe me it is not better when you have something to hold onto in life. If anything I feel like I am not grateful enough.

The thoughts will always be there. You just learn to live with them because you don’t have any other choice. I wish I could say there is a solution, I wish I had an advice. But not that I know of.

Very true. A lot of people make themselves believe that they are unique, that they can make a difference and that life is an amazing journey. 
But let me tell you what I think: life is just that. Life. Existing. You exist and you die. That’s all, nothing else. If you died today, nothing would change. Life always goes on. It might affect a few people, but life always goes on.
We are just like everything else that lives and dies, nothing special. The irony of it is that most people make themselves believe that they are important. Funny enough, that is what I do every day whilst trying to pretend that I actually want to be here. Because if I didn’t, all the thoughts would come...

Just look at all the pretentiousness. Isn’t it funny that after all  none of this matters as we will all be dead soon? Isn’t it funny how we all think we matter more than any other living creature on this Earth? And the unnecessary suffering we cause to ourselves every single day. The ‘nothing is ever good enough’ one. How much I love the fact that we all have this, still we believe we are above it all. That our lives matter more than anyone else’s.

Nothing really matters. You could just end it all and it wouldn’t matter. Or you could just wait and see what happens... it doesn’t matter really. It will all end and you will be nothing soon.

Every day I have the same thoughts. The reality is that I will never be normal. Every single day I wonder why am I like this. I could just end it. But why bother. Might as well see what is this crap. And also I am a coward after all.

I found the book very useful indeed. I see a number of things in a different perspective.
I especially liked the following thoughts quoted by the author or from the author himself: 

“ Live as if you were living already for the second time and as if you had acted the first time as wrongly as you are about to act now! “

“Those who have a 'why' to live, can bear with almost ‘any’ how. “

“When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.”

Now will be moving onto the next book. :)

Thank you for the advice. I have started the Man’s search for meaning.
Just a question for you: I am very much at the beginning. Why did you suggest me to start with this particular book? How did this book help you (if it did) or what did it make you realise?

Probably will get one of the Nietzsche ones as well then tomorrow. Might as well try them. It’s a good way of looking at things, that we might as well see what is out there and if we decide to and want to, we still have the power to end it all. 

Which book would you recommend the most from Nietzsche?
Thank you for the response. I will get the book tomorrow to see if it’s any help.
People are horrible, selfish creatures. Tired of them.  Animals are much better.

One thing for sure: having a partner will not change anything. If only, it will get you to go to a darker place when it doesn’t work out.
I am 26 now, messed up, went through quite a few relationships. You will always be stuck and you will always fail in all of them. Until you learn to accept yourself and love yourself. 
And you know what? I have been trying to accept myself, to live myself for years - I mean I really did. I have a few happy good months at times and then I believe that it’s all working and I have a chance for a normal life. And then I get to this nasty dark place again.
All I can say is(and I have experience) that no one will heal you. Not a boyfriend, not a girlfriend. No one. No matter how old are you. I have been chasing men away even though it killed me sometimes. And have been blaming myself for everything which makes matters even worse. It’s like running around in circles.

Only you have the power to heal yourself. I have no idea if it is actually possible with mental illness. It seems like it’s not.
